title: What Scripture Actually Says About Anxiety (It's Not Just Pray More)
caption:
A godly man still gets anxious. Scripture never answered that with "just pray more." It gave him something to do with the fear: name it, hand it over, take the next small step, and say it to a brother.

Save this for the night your mind won't slow down. Send it to the man who keeps saying he's fine.

#faith #scripture #anxiety #godlyman #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
